title: Mailchimp Integration Partner Program
snippet:
To become a partner, your integration must:
- Be built on the current version of the Mailchimp Marketing API
- Support OAuth 2 authentication
- Have had 25+ active users within the past 90 days
[See the full requirements in the application](https://mailchimppp.smapply.io/prog/integration_partner_program_application/)

title: Create an account
snippet:
If you don’t have a Mailchimp account already, you’ll need to [create one](https://login.mailchimp.com/signup/) in order to use the API.
The Mailchimp Marketing API provides programmatic access to Mailchimp data and functionality, allowing developers to build custom features to do things like sync email activity and campaign analytics with their database, manage audiences and campaigns, and more.
To use the Marketing API, you need a Mailchimp account. What you can do with the API depends on what [level of Mailchimp plan](https://us1.admin.mailchimp.com/account/billing-plan/) you have. Once you have an account and are logged in, you can [get an API key](https://us1.admin.mailchimp.com/account/api/) and [begin making calls to the API](/developer/marketing/build/start-developing/send-your-first-api-request).

title: Fundamentals Documentation | Mailchimp Developer
snippet:
To use the Marketing API, you need a Mailchimp account. What you can do with the API depends on what [level of Mailchimp plan](https://us1.admin.mailchimp.com/account/billing-plan/) you have. Once you have an account and are logged in, you can [get an API key](https://us1.admin.mailchimp.com/account/api/) and [begin making calls to the API](/developer/marketing/guides/quick-start/).

For building integrations that let other users access data from their own Mailchimp accounts, you should [authenticate with OAuth 2](/developer/marketing/guides/access-user-data-oauth-2/).

title: About Mailchimp & Co | Mailchimp
snippet:
**Member**
- This is the introductory level and requires only a Mailchimp account.
- After you [**connect at least two customer accounts**](https://mailchimp.com/help/connect-client-accounts/) on paid plans, you’re eligible to [**earn commission**](https://mailchimp.com/help/earn-commission/).
**Partner**
- Connect 10 or more customers on a paid Mailchimp plan.
- Complete the Mailchimp Foundations course in Mailchimp Academy.
**Pro Partner**
- Connect to 20 or more customers on a paid plan.
- Complete the Mailchimp Foundations course in Mailchimp Academy.
- Complete Email Marketing and/or Email Automations certifications in Mailchimp Academy.
